new_result.name: QFORM-SPECTRAL-BOUNDARY-NORMAL-FORM-v1
new_result.statement: For M(A,f)=sup_I P(X^TAX in I)/|I| and s=s_3(A)>=1, B=A/s satisfies s_3(B)=1 and M(B,f)=s M(A,f). Hence the full optimal constant equals the supremum restricted to s_3(A)=1. Combining partner smooth/C_0 reduction and r14 genericization, the same optimal constant is obtained on compact smooth cap-one product inputs, C_0 outputs, exact s_3=1, and any finite homogeneous algebraic genericity package.
new_result.counterexample_normal_form: If C_all=+infinity, an unbounded witness sequence exists in the normalized smooth generic class with actual attained C_0 peaks. Dilating each input by two yields marginal caps <=1/2 and only divides output height by four, so divergence persists with strict cap slack.
